tasks.title: Create the sites/mombasa folder
tasks.how: Create sites/<id> by copying the closest existing site folder, rename its files and artifactId, and add <module>sites/<id></module> to the root pom.xml. Then run scripts/site-profiles/extract.py so `detected` is filled.
tasks.note: forms_default is not_needed: in the new pom.xml exclude every form and include only the needed ones.

tasks.title: Add form F11 Family Planning Assessment
tasks.how: Forms come from distro/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/ampathforms (codes F01, F02...). sites/<site>/pom.xml either excludes every form (<exclude>distro/configs/**/ampathforms/**/*.*</exclude>) and lists the wanted ones as <include> entries, or keeps all forms and excludes the unwanted ones. Add or remove the form file there. Decisions are in `forms`: a library code (F11) with its need, short or with a note.

tasks.title: Build the site-specific form General consultation
tasks.how: Site-specific forms are entries of `forms` with custom: true: build the form JSON, add it to the distro ampathforms folder with the next free F-code, add it to `catalog.forms`, replace the site-specific key with that code (dropping custom), then include it in the site's pom.xml.
tasks.done_when: MBA-GC is replaced by a library code that is in detected.forms
tasks.note: Combines OPD General (F44) and Gynaecology (F73). Specs to finalize

tasks.title: Build the site's own registration form
tasks.how: sectionDefinitions of @openmrs/esm-patient-registration-app in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/frontend_config/*.json; person attributes in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/personattributetypes/*.csv.
tasks.done_when: the registration config in sites/mombasa is site-specific (checked by a person)
tasks.note: Site-specific registration form (F00) defined in the Mombasa metadata file

tasks.title: Add the location Mombasa Health Facility
tasks.how: sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/locations/*.csv.
tasks.done_when: Mombasa Health Facility is in detected.locations

tasks.title: Set up DHIS2 reporting (OpenFn)
tasks.how: DHIS2 reporting runs in OpenFn: sites/<site>/configs/openfn/<project>.yaml (workflow triggers must be enabled), with changelog.md listing the version and the forms mapped. staging_project.yaml holds forms being tested.
tasks.note: DHIS2 needs to be confirmed with the project.
